**TL;DR**: At Salesforce's Dreamforce, business leaders reportedly said last year's models already handle most of their practical needs, CNBC writes — a reality check on the frontier-model race.

### Key points
- Per CNBC, many enterprise practitioners said last year's models are "good enough" for their workloads.
- The frontier debate over model capability and safety diverged from what buyers actually deploy.
- Attention appears to be shifting from "the most powerful model" toward "the model that fits the job at the right cost."

### Why it matters
Even as capability races continue, enterprise buying favors stability, cost, and ease of integration over sheer novelty. The AI safety conversation is moving from abstract risk toward a practical bar: is this safe enough to ship now?
